detail: JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V. (FMO) in connection with its investment in the private placement of secured, senior, unlisted, redeemable and non-convertible debentures issued by Sahyadri Farmers Producer Company Limited. The JSA Finance team was led by Soumitra Majumdar (Partner), with support from Shrijita Bhattacharya (Partner) and Shekhar Shrivastava (Counsel).
